description: Unit tests for the Basket entity in the eShopOnWeb project, specifically testing the AddItem method behavior in various scenarios.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: A unit test class using Xunit to test the behavior of adding items to a Basket.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an item to the basket when it is not present results in the item being added with correct properties.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an existing item increments its quantity correctly.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures that the unit price remains the initial one when additional items are added with different prices.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Checks that if AddItem is called without specifying quantity, it defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Verifies that adding an item with a negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to add an existing item with a negative quantity throws an exception.
